versions.changelog:
acp-harness-delegation v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides a standard protocol for delegating tasks via ACP runtime to acpx-enabled harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Codex).
- Details trigger phrases and proper session spawning workflow with detailed configuration and error-handling guidance.
- Documents authentication and permissions prerequisites for successful execution.
- Offers troubleshooting tips and known issues for common integration errors.
- Includes configuration recommendations and clarifications for session reuse and safe operation.
